mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of sustained GDP growth, or GDP growth decelerates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate crosses above 4.5%, market expectations of prolonged tightening suppress equity valuations, generating negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite the rate crossing above 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (demand) and contraction in supply (INDPRO below 102) creates upward pressure on asset prices, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or 20-day returns not positive when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high labor demand (PAYEMS > 1.5M) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signal robust job market growth, supporting equity valuations and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the trigger condition, or the regime is not confirmed by other indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate profit margins and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during sustained supply growth, or growth decelerates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate crosses above 4%, market expectations of weakening labor demand suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain non-negative despite the unemployment rate crossing above 4%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor demand (PAYEMS > 1.5M) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) create a strong labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns not positive when trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP (demand) coupled with a decline in the Federal Funds Rate (monetary contraction) lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns not positive when trigger occurs.
